description: The plot illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the model variants, labeled as "Full model (MS-FSLHate)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with no numeric scale or units. The y-axis is labeled with percentage values, ranging from an unspecified lower limit to an unspecified upper limit, with no explicit units but implied to be percentages. Three lines are shown: a line for precision, a line for recall, and a line for F1-score, each with distinct markers or colors, although the exact colors and marker shapes are not specified. The precision line starts at 65.45% for the full model and decreases to 61.06% for "w/o Prompt", then increases slightly to 64.06% for "w/o Attention" before ending at 65.44% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The recall line begins at 65.78% for the full model, decreases to 59.64% for "w/o Prompt", then increases to 63.75% for "w/o Augmentation" before dropping to 56.82% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The F1-score line starts at 65.56% for the full model, decreases to 60.16% for "w/o Prompt", then increases slightly to 62.63% for "w/o Augmentation" before ending at 57.74% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
